scope.population: Previously exposed fixed48 validation engineering records.

interpretation: Positive V46-minus-V39 means more time. 288 observations repeat the same 48 queries six times; they are not 288 independent queries. Positive-mass concentration excludes negative offsets from its denominator. Pooled-observation positive mass and positive mass after summing each position are distinct denominators. Positions are anonymous 1-based subset indexes; no original keys, hashes, ordinals or SQL rows are published. The 1 ms band is descriptive, not statistical significance. Tail commit is not allocated to a query. Timing records locate observed differences without proving decoder or host-load causality.
